title: Dimension Similarity Query
description: Query parameters for the dimension-similarity conformance class. The 'similar' parameter carries the reference value against which members are ranked by vector-embedding proximity. The 'limit' parameter (k of k-NN) caps the result set.

similar.description: Reference value (member code, free-text label, or embedding identifier — provider-defined) against which dimension members are ranked by embedding-space proximity.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (k of k-NN).
